_comment: Migration-only scope list for the decision-parity gate (scripts/library/test/decision_parity.py,
wrapped by scripts/test/decision-parity-gate.ps1). While this file exists, the shared domain ids
listed under 'domains' are the ONLY ones the gate can fail on; every role in any other domain is
reported but never fails. The literal 'undomained' may be listed to gate the roles that resolve to
no shared domain. A domain is added here once every role in it has been brought to language-axis
decision parity, and the list only grows -- an entry is never removed. When every domain is in
scope this file is DELETED and the gate runs unscoped: every domain in scope, hard zero.
-Scope on the wrapper (--scope on the module) overrides this list for one run.
